verdict.rationale: TaxJar provides official SDKs across seven languages (Ruby, Python, PHP, Node, C#/.NET, Java, Go) with GitHub-hosted client libraries exposing typed methods like createOrder, validateAddress, and nexusRegions, plus API docs, auth, versioning, and a sandbox endpoint for development. Missing for 10: no official OpenAPI/machine-readable spec or llms.txt was found (both probed and 404), and no independent developer testimonials on SDK quality/agentic usage.
